input.summary:
Woodshed interior built in parts/room-5.mjs: a chopping stump at (11,1,20) with a standing lantern on it as the focal piece, a kindling barrel at (9,1,20), and two hanging lanterns at (7,4,19) and (5,4,18) under the roof slabs.
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt with no refused writes or off-palette blocks; `mcd room --only Woodshed` says OK (23 of 24 floor cells reachable, the 24th is the stump; min light 9, 0 dark, 0 dim).
The lane x=5..8 from the back door (7,1,18) and the open south side is kept clear; the room render from above reads correctly.
left: Cordwood x=9..12, z=18..19 belongs to the grounds part, which was still a stub in this copy; the walk and light checks ran with those cells empty, so re-run `mcd room --only Woodshed` after the merge.
The splitting maul is not a block, so it is not placed; the stump stands alone as the chopping block.
plan.md's checklist only lists P1..P6, so there is no room tick to make; I did not edit plan.md, per the edit rule.

waste.what: Light placement worked out by hand: I computed each lantern's light reach at the floor corners from the room tool's dim cells, then re-ran make.sh to see the lift.
waste.cost: 2 make.sh runs and 1 manual distance estimate
waste.tool: `mcd room --only` should print a ready-to-paste hangLantern(...) call with the support cell already checked, not only the suggested spot.

waste.what: Floor coordinates typed by hand as a 3-row text layer, with the column index for each x counted by eye.
waste.tool: `mcd plan --only` could print the x-index ruler beside each row so column-to-x mapping needs no counting.

companions.task: Splitting the cordwood stack and the chopping block by the grounds part, and placing the splitting maul stand, which is not a block here.
Making the kindling barrel and its lid as a real barrel with contents, not a plain block.
